crossRefs.note: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about…
Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and…
Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

translations.web: But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know. They are destroyed in these things that they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason.
translations.bsb: These men, however, slander what they do not understand, and like irrational animals, they will be destroyed by the things they do instinctively.
translations.kjv: But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.
translations.asv: But these rail at whatsoever things they know not: and what they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason, in these things are they destroyed.
